thread:
Maya S: Heads-up — time for our quarterly RBAC refresh. I'm proposing a quick 2-week sweep to remove stale admin-level bindings and reconcile audit-log gaps. Volunteers to run the checks?

Dylan: +1. I can run the role-binding query for GCP projects and post results.

Maya S: thanks Dylan. Query to run: ```gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJECT --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role|test("roles/(owner|editor|iam.admin|cloudkms.admin)"))'```

Kevin: FWIW we should also cross-check KMS grants. There's been odd serviceaccount bindings in `redwood-payments` that look outdated :grimacing:

Ellie: I'll do the KMS cross-check. Question: what's our retention window for audit logs we can use for proof? Is it 180 days or 90?

Maya S: Audit retention is 365 for infra logs, but some project-level audit sinks only keep 90. Use centralized-sink first, fall back to project logs. Note the gap in `staging-eu`.

Audit-Bot: Auto-scan completed for 5246801234. Found 7 bindings in infra projects with no owner label. See link: https://internal/reports/5246801234

Dylan: Pasted output (snip): ```{ "role": "roles/iam.admin", "members": ["serviceAccount:old-deployer@..."] }``` Looks orphaned.

Kevin: Plan: 1) owners@team ping for 48h 2) revoke bindings after 7d 3) record change in access-tracker doc. Any objections?

Ellie: fine with that cadence. For KMS, I'll open a ticket and attach `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` snippets.

Maya S: I'll kick off the owners@ ping. @Oncall-Bot please add a calendar reminder for follow-up on 7 days from now :calendar:

Oncall-Bot: Reminder created for 7 days. Assigned to Maya S.

Maya S: Action items: Dylan — run the full IAM query across accounts and upload CSV. Ellie — KMS key binding audit. Kevin — prepare rollback runbook for accidental revoke. I'll draft the PR for the policy change and tag security-review. Thanks.

Kevin: I'll draft rollback runbook and add quick `gcloud` restore command examples.

Dylan: uploading CSV now to https://internal/doc/access-refresh/5246801234.csv :thumbsup:

Maya S: Great. Keep thread updated if you hit any weird cross-project grants. If anyone spots something that looks like privilege escalation risk, ping sec-oncall.

Ellie: Noted. Found one SA with double roles across prod and staging that likely needs separation. I'll flag in ticket.

Maya S: Awesome, thanks all.
